scope: Reusable ordinary-user static compilation of the frozen signal.mask-restore payload and default diagnostic collector, plus Linux reference execution of the payload only. No collector execution, native production build, root, Docker or guest authority.

python_capture_runner.scope: Standard-library command/capture/status observer and initial signal-mask observation only; no arbitrary repository imports.

source_and_include_inspection.payload: Read complete frozen source. It uses only installed signal.h/stdio.h/stdlib.h, installs a local SIGUSR1 handler, raises that signal in its own process, queries its mask and prints one line. No file, network, privilege, child-process or external host-state operation.
source_and_include_inspection.collector: Read complete default collector source, including every conditional include/flag and main. All includes are installed system headers; no project include, generated include, build script, plugin, external command during preprocessing or custom search path. Installed direct headers exist. ND_CORE_*, ND_FUTEX and other profile definitions are forbidden for this admission.
source_and_include_inspection.collector_execution: Not admitted on the host. The resulting init is only an artifact: its PID1/root path mounts filesystems, accesses klog, loads modules and performs guest shutdown. Its compilation does not grant that execution authority.
source_and_include_inspection.transitive_headers: Use only GCC's installed standard include search under cleared environment. -MD/-MF captures the actual system/project include dependency closure for each compile; retain and hash consumed headers from that depfile with the actual build evidence. Selected header hashes above are not a claim to inventory the complete transitive closure before preprocessing.

command_profile.fresh_output_root: One exclusive mkdtemp directory /home/holden/mckernel-work/scratch/signal-mask-restore-compile-20261017-XXXXXX with private HOME, TMPDIR and case/work subdirectories. Never use or overwrite a historical attempt.
command_profile.capture_observer: Pinned Python -B standard-library observer may record exact argv/environment, initial signal.pthread_sigmask(SIG_BLOCK, set()), subprocess returncode/stdout/stderr, timeout status, file hashes and depfile/header identities. It refuses a baseline with SIGUSR1 or SIGUSR2 blocked and does not alter the frozen source, oracle or inherited mask to conceal that condition. Run payload with subprocess.run(..., capture_output=True, timeout=10) and the sanitized environment, retaining raw streams/status before comparing the frozen oracle. No collector execution or repository launcher import is admitted.
command_profile.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LC_ALL=C LANG=C TZ=UTC PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 HOME=<fresh>/home TMPDIR=<fresh>/tmp. No credentials, SUDO_ASKPASS, LD_*, GCC_EXEC_PREFIX, COMPILER_PATH, LIBRARY_PATH, CPATH, C_INCLUDE_PATH, PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME, toolchain overrides or unrelated launcher variables.
command_profile.read_only_identity_commands: Pinned tools --version, gcc -dumpmachine/-print-file-name/-print-prog-name, dpkg-query package versions, read-only stat/readlink/hash checks and ELF header/program-header/symbol inspection of the produced files are allowed. No toolchain installation or fallback.

resources.aggregate: One job/2 GiB deducted from the shared seven-job/24-GiB allowance. May overlap CPU0 ordinary materialization only under dispatcher accounting; creates no heavy lease or guest concurrency.
resources.caveat: Per-process AS/CPU/file-size limits are not aggregate cgroup quotas. The process count is maintained by this small serial GCC/assembler/linker or payload family, not per-user RLIMIT_NPROC. Preserve existing host/scratch capacity floors.

evidence_and_failure_policy.retain: Retain source/oracle/tool hashes, exact commands/environment and initial signal mask, stdout/stderr and statuses for both compiles and payload run, generated binaries, depfiles and header hashes under the fresh output root, including every failed attempt. Save timeout/exception information explicitly; stdout text is not a substitute for raw captured bytes.
evidence_and_failure_policy.prior_failure: The historical container's missing-static-libc compile failure remains retained. This admitted host environment is a concrete environment change: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.a is a verified regular 5,747,618-byte archive and all listed static startup/libgcc inputs exist. It is not an unchanged retry of that environment.
evidence_and_failure_policy.limits: No compilation/link or Linux payload execution was performed by this reviewer. Presence of dependencies is profile admission, not a successful static-link claim. On deterministic failure preserve it and apply the campaign's one bounded correction/failure-family escalation; do not rerun unchanged.
evidence_and_failure_policy.semantic_limits: SIGUSR1/SIGUSR2 baseline observation preserves the preparation limitation. The frozen payload checks restoration of those two mask bits and handler SIGUSR2 blocking; it does not prove arbitrary whole-mask restoration or automatic blocking of the delivered signal. Linux reference success supplies no McKernel/formal acceptance.
